verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes an API versioning guide, but it describes only a proposed approach while the API is in beta. All existing resources are frozen 'as is' as 'version 0', so there is no actual multi-version scheme in production. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or change-notification process. Missing for 10: implemented API versioning beyond an implicit version 0, a documented deprecation/sunset policy, change-notification commitments, independent corroboration of version stability.
